motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}

visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle radial gradients in backgrounds to create depth, e.g., 'bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-slate-100 via-white to-white'

general: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Do NOT use generic 'SaaS Blue' - stick to the Deep Navy Brand Color.
Ensure all images have lazy loading and alt text.
accessibility: Ensure color contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
Interactive elements must have a minimum target size of 44x44px.
Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-offset-2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the specified Google Fonts via import in index.css.
Implement the Navigation Bar as a persistent layout component.
Create a 'Layout' wrapper that handles the sticky navbar and footer.
Disclosure page must list dummy documents (PDF icons) and mandatory info tables.
Contact form must connect to a backend endpoint (mocked or real).
Use the provided image URLs strictly.
